checks.statement: Carousel items move with a parallax effect while scrolling.

sourceHistory.summary: Curated from the captured Scrolling instructions.

evidence.result: Codex in-app Chromium 155 on Linux, normal motion unless stated; Catalog http://100.103.168.9:8085, assessed runtime 6301a60af14d437e902b180c200020884a8bc213. Fractional clock samples at 25% and 50% keep multi-browse images 168px wide while masks and image offsets move. This establishes reveal geometry, not timing fidelity. Motion Lab imported all six upstream clips; visually checked corner tracking and fitted easing/spring comparisons were obtained for multi-browse and centered hero. Hero feature tracking drifted into the image and was rejected as mask-edge evidence. Release timing cannot be isolated reliably from all gesture demonstrations, and generic parallax prose must be read alongside the rigid uncontained examples. No universal duration is inferred. Reproduce fitting in sibling ui-motion: import the linked multi-browse and centered reference clips into a temporary --projects directory; track --method feature --start 120 --end 180 --search 70 with regions 680,300,65,65 and 939,300,65,65 respectively; measure --curve emphasized --fit. Over this 2.0-3.0s whole-transition interval, fitted durations are 1182ms/1177ms and RMS errors 6.96px/2.43px. These are observed image-space transitions, not isolated release durations or normative settings.

implementation.notes: Fractional clock samples at 25% and 50% keep multi-browse images 168px wide while masks and image offsets move. This establishes reveal geometry, not timing fidelity. Motion Lab imported all six upstream clips; visually checked corner tracking and fitted easing/spring comparisons were obtained for multi-browse and centered hero. Hero feature tracking drifted into the image and was rejected as mask-edge evidence. Release timing cannot be isolated reliably from all gesture demonstrations, and generic parallax prose must be read alongside the rigid uncontained examples. No universal duration is inferred.
